title: ALMA Band 2 line survey of a z = 3.44 clumpy strongly lensed submillimetre galaxy
question: What are the molecular and dense gas inventory and ISM conditions of the strongly lensed z = 3.44 submillimetre galaxy SPT-S J002706-5007.4 using the new ALMA Band 2 receivers, and how will Band 2 perform for future high-redshift spectroscopic surveys?

data.angular_resolution: Band 2 cubes: 0.62x0.47 arcsec to 0.87x0.76 arcsec; Band 2 continuum: 0.72x0.60 arcsec; Band 3: 4.85x4.52 arcsec, 1.25x1.02 arcsec, 1.5x1.4 arcsec; Band 7: 50x44 mas
data.sensitivity: Band 2 cubes: 0.73-1.33 mJy/beam per 35 km/s bin (~0.63 mJy/beam in 0.2 GHz overlaps); Band 2 continuum: 5.6 uJy/beam; Band 3: 1.7-1.0 mJy/beam, 0.4 mJy/beam (10 km/s), 0.25 mJy/beam (35 km/s); Band 7 continuum: 38 uJy/beam

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA Band 2, Band 3, and Band 7 datasets
recipe.method: Calibrate data using the ALMA Pipeline / SCRIPTFORPI.PY (or retrieve archive cubes for 2015.1.00504.S), then image cubes and continuum using CASA TCLEAN with natural weighting (robust = 2) and auto-masking; average line-free channels for Band 2 continuum.
key_parameters: robust = 2 (natural weighting); 35 km/s bins (Band 2 and 2022.1.00526.S), 10 km/s bins (2022.1.00172.S); auto-masking

recipe.goal: Extract full spectra and velocity-integrated line fluxes
recipe.method: Extract full spectra using a single wide aperture extending down to 2-sigma in Band 2 dust continuum widened by two beams. Extract individual continuum-subtracted line fluxes using the Band 2 continuum image smoothed to the cube resolution and widened by up to five beams depending on SNR.
key_parameters: 2-sigma Band 2 continuum contour widened by 2 beams (for full spectrum) or up to 5 beams (for individual line fluxes); >4-sigma detection in moment-0 map

recipe.goal: Derive line luminosity ratios, ISM conditions, and dense gas fraction
recipe.method: Calculate CO(4-3)/CO(3-2) flux ratio, [C I]/CO(4-3) and HCN(5-4)/CO(4-3) line luminosity ratios using Solomon (2005) equations, compare [C I] ratios to PDR models, and compute dense-to-molecular gas mass fraction using conversion factors and excitation ratios.
assumptions: Flat Lambda-CDM cosmology with Omega_m = 0.315, Omega_Lambda = 0.685, h = 0.674
alpha_HCN = 10 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1, alpha_CO = 1 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1, r_4,1 = 1 for CO, r_5,1 = 0.25 for HCN

recipe.goal: Measure clump flux contribution from high-resolution Band 7 continuum
recipe.method: Measure the flux of the clumpy extended emission between the four lensed images in Band 7 and compare to the total emission of the source.

recipe.goal: Evaluate redshift search efficiency of ALMA Band 2 and WSU configurations
recipe.method: Use public redshift search optimisation tool to compute redshift identification probability as a function of redshift for filled Band 3 vs Band 2 WSU setups (8 GHz and 14 GHz bandwidths), and compare Band 2 vs Band 4 observing time efficiency for a fiducial DSFG.
key_parameters: WSU candidate instantaneous sideband bandwidths of 8 GHz (3 tunings) and 14 GHz (2 tunings covering 67-115 GHz)
assumptions: Fiducial DSFG with L_IR = 10^12 L_sun, CO SLED scaling from Hagimoto et al. (2023), HerBS and SPT redshift distributions, and analytical sensitivity equation from ALMA Technical Handbook
